title: Purified Water system FAT and SAT to EU GMP Annex 15 | Aquemi
meta: Factory acceptance test (FAT) of your Purified Water package in polypropylene, to a protocol your quality unit approves, then a site acceptance test (SAT) on your feed water. Protocols written for reuse in IQ/OQ under EU GMP Annex 15, 3.6 and GUI-0029, 8.1.
eyebrow: FAT · SAT · EU GMP ANNEX 15 · GUI-0029
headline: Watch it run on water before it ships
lead: Your quality unit approves the protocol; we run the factory acceptance test (FAT) on your Purified Water package. A site acceptance test (SAT) proves the rest on your site.

items.q: Will our quality unit accept FAT results in place of IQ/OQ tests?
items.a: Yes, if it approves the reuse before the factory acceptance test (FAT) and has assessed us (ASTM E2500). Under EU good manufacturing practice (GMP) Annex 15, 3.6, and GUI-0029, 8.1, transport and installation must not change the result. We propose candidate tests for installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ).

items.q: What if a test fails while you are watching?
items.a: It is recorded as found, as a deviation. We investigate, fix and retest that case and any case the fix could affect, with you witnessing.

items.q: Is the software we see at FAT the software that ships?
items.a: Its version and checksum are recorded at the factory acceptance test (FAT) [confirm]. Any later change goes through change control and is shown again at the site acceptance test (SAT).

items.q: How long does a FAT take?
items.a: [FAT duration, days] for the full Purified Water package, pretreatment to distribution, and [typical FAT duration, single module, days] for one module. Packages over [largest skid size, m] are tested module by module.
